name: Closed-Form Triangle Splatting (CF-Splat)
aliases: Closed-Form Triangle Splatting with Mesh Priors
definition: A closed-form triangle-splatting framework for efficient scene appearance estimation over a known mesh (pre-existing or from upstream pipelines) using calibrated cameras, formulating rendered pixel colors linearly with respect to per-vertex spherical harmonics (SH) coefficients to solve a global linear least-squares (LLS) problem without iterative nonlinear optimization.
summary: Closed-Form Triangle Splatting efficiently estimates scene appearance on known meshes by solving a single linear least-squares problem, avoiding iterative optimization and significantly reducing computation time and memory usage.
